verdict.rationale: Formant's marketing says users can ask the fleet questions in plain language and receive governed, ML-driven task recommendations, with people approving the next step. Its orchestration assigns jobs to suitable robots, and commands trigger predefined actions. That adds up to natural-language querying plus recommended tasks with human approval, not clearly natural-language task expression that the platform plans and executes on its own. Missing for 10: documented natural-language task input (as opposed to status questions), evidence of autonomous task planning or decomposition, an explicit link from approved recommendations to command execution, and technical docs or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
